description: Kisqali in combination with an aromatase inhibitor for the adjuvant treatment of patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence. In pre- or perimenopausal women, or in men, the aromatase inhibitor should be combined with a luteinising hormone-releasing hormone (LHRH) agonist.

contributions.description: On 2024-12-16, the EMA published an EPAR - Assessment report - Variation for Kisqali (ribociclib) that added an extension indication to ribociclib in combination with an aromatase inhibitor for the treatment of the adjuvant treatment of patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.
